# @cosmjs/encoding Agent Guide

> **Package**: `@cosmjs/encoding` v0.38.0 **Purpose**: Encoding utilities (hex,
> base64, bech32, UTF-8, ASCII) **Layer**: Foundation Layer (no CosmJS
> dependencies)

## Package Overview

Provides encoding/decoding utilities that don't rely on Node.js Buffer and
provide better error messages. Can be used independently of blockchain code.

## Key Exports

| Function                                      | Purpose             | Example                                     |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `toHex(data)` / `fromHex(str)`                | Hex encoding        | `toHex(new Uint8Array([1, 2]))` → `"0102"`  |
| `toBase64(data)` / `fromBase64(str)`          | Base64 encoding     | `toBase64(data)` → `"AQID"`                 |
| `toBech32(prefix, data)` / `fromBech32(addr)` | Bech32 addresses    | `toBech32("cosmos", data)` → `"cosmos1..."` |
| `toUtf8(str)` / `fromUtf8(data)`              | UTF-8 strings       | `toUtf8("hello")` → `Uint8Array`            |
| `toAscii(str)` / `fromAscii(data)`            | ASCII strings       | ASCII only, throws on non-ASCII             |
| `toRfc3339(date)` / `fromRfc3339(str)`        | RFC 3339 timestamps | ISO 8601 format                             |

## Common Usage

```typescript
import {
  toHex,
  fromHex,
  toBech32,
  fromBech32,
  toBase64,
} from "@cosmjs/encoding";

// Hex
const hex = toHex(new Uint8Array([255, 0, 128])); // "ff0080"
const bytes = fromHex("ff0080");

// Bech32 (Cosmos addresses)
const address = toBech32("cosmos", addressBytes);
const { prefix, data } = fromBech32("cosmos1...");

// Base64
const b64 = toBase64(data);
```

## Common Mistakes

❌ **WRONG**: Using Node.js Buffer

```typescript
const hex = Buffer.from(data).toString("hex"); // Don't use Buffer
```

✅ **CORRECT**: Use @cosmjs/encoding

```typescript
const hex = toHex(data);
```
